_note: 學習路徑內容第25批 #1／6：未來進行式 future progressive（eng.t_adv.verb.future-progressive，學測級／高階）。will be + V-ing 表未來某時間點正在進行的動作（This time tomorrow I'll be flying to Tokyo），常搭 at 8 tonight／this time next week 等時間點；亦可表既定將發生之事或婉轉詢問對方計畫（Will you be using the car?）。誘答鎖『缺 be／缺 -ing／用現在進行式／用簡單未來只敘述整件事而非進行中』等結構性錯誤，確保唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix fpg_）。

units.can_do: 我能用 will be + V-ing 描述未來某個時間點正在進行的動作，並辨別它和簡單未來式（will do）的差別。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: The future progressive is formed with 'will be + verb-ing' and describes an action that will be in progress at a specific time in the future: 'This time tomorrow I will be flying to Tokyo.'
claims.verification_ref: will be + V-ing 表未來某時間點進行中的動作（This time tomorrow I'll be flying to Tokyo）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 代入朗讀複核

claims.text: The future progressive often appears with a time expression marking a point in the future, such as 'at eight o'clock tonight' or 'this time next week': 'At eight tonight I will be studying.'
claims.verification_ref: 未來進行式常搭未來時間點（at 8 tonight／this time next week）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Compare 'will be doing' (in progress at a future moment) with the simple future 'will do' (the whole action, often a decision or promise): 'At ten I will be working' describes the activity in progress, while 'I will work hard tomorrow' states the whole action.
claims.verification_ref: will be doing（某時刻進行中）對比 will do（整件事/決定/承諾）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The future progressive can politely ask about someone's existing plans: 'Will you be using the car this evening?' asks about a plan without pressing the person to commit.
claims.verification_ref: Will you be using...? 婉轉詢問對方既定計畫；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: The future progressive is 'will be + verb-ing'. It describes an action that will be happening at a point in the future.
teach.zh_hint: 未來進行式＝will be + V-ing，描述未來某個時間點『正在進行』的動作。

teach.body: This time tomorrow I will be flying to Tokyo.
teach.zh_hint: 明天這個時候，我正在飛往東京的途中。will be + flying 表屆時進行中。

teach.body: We often add a future time point, such as 'at eight tonight' or 'this time next week'.
teach.zh_hint: 常搭一個未來時間點，例如 at eight tonight、this time next week。

teach.body: At eight o'clock tonight I will be studying for my exam.
teach.zh_hint: 今晚八點我正在準備考試。at eight tonight 標出進行中的時間點。

teach.body: Use 'will be doing' for an action in progress at a future moment; use 'will do' for the whole action. 'Will you be doing...?' also politely asks about someone's plans.
teach.zh_hint: will be doing＝某時刻進行中；will do＝整件事；Will you be ...? 可婉轉問對方的計畫。

teach.body: Don't call at nine; we will be having dinner then.
teach.zh_hint: 九點別打來，我們那時正在吃晚餐。will be having 表屆時進行中。

practice.stem: 選正確：This time next week, I ____ on a beach in Hawaii.（未來進行式：will be + V-ing）

distractor_rationales.will lying: 少了 be；未來進行式是 will be + V-ing，不能說 will lying。
distractor_rationales.will be lie: be 後面要接 V-ing（lying），不是原形 lie。
distractor_rationales.am lying: am lying 是現在進行式；這裡講的是未來某時間點，要用 will be lying。

practice.feedback: will be lying：will be + V-ing 表未來某時間點正在進行。

practice.stem: 選正確：At ten o'clock tonight, we ____ the final match on TV.（那個時間點正在看）

distractor_rationales.will watching: 少了 be；正確是 will be watching。
distractor_rationales.were watching: were watching 是過去進行式；今晚十點是未來時間點，要用未來進行式 will be watching。
distractor_rationales.will be watch: be 之後要用 V-ing（watching），不是原形 watch。

practice.feedback: will be watching：at ten tonight 標出未來進行中的時間點。

practice.stem: 選正確：____ the printer this afternoon? I need it for an hour.（婉轉詢問對方今天下午是否會用）

distractor_rationales.Do you use: Do you use 問的是『習慣/通常』，不是今天下午的計畫；婉轉問計畫用 Will you be using。
distractor_rationales.Are you use: 文法不通；be 後不接原形 use。
distractor_rationales.Will you using: 少了 be；正確是 Will you be using。

practice.feedback: Will you be using...?：用未來進行式婉轉詢問對方既定計畫。

practice.stem: 選正確：明天這個時候我會正在開會（強調屆時『正在進行中』，而非只陳述會做這件事）。
practice.answer: I will be attending a meeting at this time tomorrow.
options: I will be attending a meeting at this time tomorrow.
I will attend a meeting at this time tomorrow.
I will be attend a meeting at this time tomorrow.
I will have attended a meeting at this time tomorrow.

distractor_rationales.I will attend a meeting at this time tom: will attend 陳述『整件事會發生』；本題要強調屆時『正在進行中』，所以用未來進行式 will be attending 較貼切。
distractor_rationales.I will be attend a meeting at this time: be 後要用 V-ing（attending），不是原形 attend。
distractor_rationales.I will have attended a meeting at this t: will have attended（未來完成式）表示屆時『已經開完』，與『正在進行中』意思相反。

practice.feedback: will be attending：強調未來某時刻動作正在進行，用未來進行式。

practice.stem: 選出正確的句子：（下週五下午三點，我正在飛往東京的途中）
practice.answer: At three o'clock next Friday, I will be flying to Tokyo.
options: At three o'clock next Friday, I will be flying to Tokyo.
At three o'clock next Friday, I will flying to Tokyo.
At three o'clock next Friday, I will be fly to Tokyo.
At three o'clock next Friday, I will been flying to Tokyo.

distractor_rationales.At three o'clock next Friday, I will fly: 少了 be；正確是 will be flying。
distractor_rationales.At three o'clock next Friday, I will be: be 後要用 V-ing（flying），不是原形 fly。
distractor_rationales.At three o'clock next Friday, I will bee: will 後面接原形 be，不是 been；正確是 will be flying。

practice.feedback: will be flying：will be + V-ing 完整形式。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: This time tomorrow I will be flying to Tokyo.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：will be flying（will be + V-ing）、This time tomorrow 時間點、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。will be 輕讀、V-ing 重音，句尾下收。

lines.text: At eight tonight I will be studying for my exam.
lines.intonation: will be 輕讀、studying 重音、exam 句尾下收

lines.text: Will you be using the car this evening?
lines.intonation: 句尾 evening 上揚（yes/no 問句）
